title: Platform Features
requiredTextNote: Some text tags are required and always enabled (shown disabled).
featuresWarning: Disabling these options can remove major authoring and administration capabilities.
largeSiteWarning: This site has many pages. Skeleton generation may take a while.
skeletonLargeSiteConfirm: This site has {count} pages. Generating a skeleton may take a while and create a large file. Continue?
addPageFeatureDescription: Allows creating new pages from the top bar, outline actions, and command search actions.
deletePageFeatureDescription: Allows deleting pages from page actions, outline actions, and related admin flows.
outlineDesignerFeatureDescription: Enables site structure tools, including outline actions and Structure admin operations.
styleGuideFeatureDescription: Shows Style Guide access in admin tools and command search shortcuts.
insightsFeatureDescription: Enables Reports in admin and command search so analytics and insights views are available.
siteManifestFeatureDescription: Controls Site Settings sections for Details, Blocks, and Editor configuration.
themeManifestFeatureDescription: Enables the Appearance/Theme settings section in site administration.
authorManifestFeatureDescription: Enables author profile and author metadata settings in site administration.
seoManifestFeatureDescription: Enables search engine and metadata optimization settings in site administration.
pageBreakFeatureDescription: Shows page-level metadata editing controls like title, icon, status, tags, and locking.
addBlockFeatureDescription: Shows the blocks browser and allows adding new content blocks while editing.
popularGizmosFeatureDescription: Shows the Popular blocks section inside the block picker.
recentGizmosFeatureDescription: Shows the Recent blocks section inside the block picker.
contentMapFeatureDescription: Shows the page content map/structure panel while editing content.
viewSourceFeatureDescription: Enables HTML source view for direct page markup editing.
uploadMediaFeatureDescription: Enables file upload workflows and related media/file management access.
onlineMediaFeatureDescription: Enables online media integrations and remote media search sources.
communityFeatureDescription: Enables community-related command search context and outreach-oriented actions.
